# ThumbsRating

```ts
import { ThumbsRating } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A read-only thumbs up / down result — what someone said about an answer, an article or a recommendation. It shows the result; it doesn't take input. To let people give feedback on an AI response, use AiFeedback; for a star score, use Star Rating.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `'up' \| 'down' \| null` | **required** | The result: thumbs up, thumbs down, or null for no rating yet. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'lg'` | `'sm'` | sm 28px thumbs (regular 12 label), lg 32px (medium 16 label). |
| `label` | `string` | — | Optional label after the thumbs ("Feedback"). |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<ThumbsRating value="up" />
<ThumbsRating value="down" label="Feedback" />
<ThumbsRating value={null} label="Not rated yet" />
<ThumbsRating value="up" size="lg" label="Helpful" />
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-primary-primary`, `--color-rating-empty`, `--space-050`, `--color-text-icon-primary`, `--type-size-caption`, `--type-size-subject`, `--space-100`

## Accessibility

- role="img" named "<label>: thumbs up" (label defaults to "Feedback"); the glyphs and visible label are hidden so nothing is read twice.
- Filled vs outline shows the result without relying on color.
- Not focusable — it's a result, not a control.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Show a recorded thumbs result | Use it as clickable feedback — that's AiFeedback |
| Show value={null} when nothing's recorded | Hide the component and leave a gap |
| Label what the result is about | Mix thumbs and stars for the same question |
